subject: LOCK MODE clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.9.4 5) 'Records locks are obtained only when the LOCK phrase is explicitly specified on an I-O statement.' OK. Under MANUAL, ReadSetsRecordLock returns true only for FileRecordLock.WithLock. WriteShared/RewriteShared set wantLock only when phrase == WithLock. Probe rt1.cob phase 1 checks both halves. (i) B (MANUAL) read record 1 with a plain READ and got '00'; A then read record 1 and got '00' (A-READ1-B-MANUAL-NOLOCK), so the unphrased MANUAL READ set no lock. (ii) `READ B WITH LOCK` on record 3 got '00' and A's read of record 3 got '51', so the explicit phrase does lock. Existing goldens witness only half (ii) (pb683_open_sharing_read_only, pb338_read_conflict_position, 2002/file_sharing). None witnesses half (i), so test-ref is empty (test-needed). [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the clause is absent from ISO 1989:1985; it arrives with the 2002 file sharing / record locking facility, D.2.4 / A.4.7; no later change to 12.4.5.9 located)]
